text: Steenbarger: ratify in_zone:ma_20 (D), the retracement trigger elder-lens and I both named: a first pullback that holds the 20-day line, then an hourly close above the prior day's high (C2, C7). wrong_if: a daily close back below ma_20 after that pullback, minervini's test too. Regime: valid only in an ADX-strong trend (C7); `subcomponents.mp.adx_val` 27.38 is under 30, so not yet. close_above:pivot_high buys a thrust at `subcomponents.energy.en_pos50` 91.5, none of my four set-ups. I hold OPPOSE; it clears when adx_val is above 30 and that pullback holds.
